title: Rapamycin treatment for Alzheimer's disease and related dementias: a pilot phase 1 clinical trial
book_use: Chapter 11; The Rapamycin Underground; Checked 2026-09-02; Supports: eight-week open-label 1 mg/day rapamycin study in ten participants with mild cognitive impairment or early dementia; rapamycin was not detectable in cerebrospinal fluid after treatment; several Alzheimer disease and inflammatory biomarkers increased from baseline; Limits: Very small, uncontrolled, disease-specific phase 1 study. It is useful for target-engagement uncertainty, not as evidence about healthy aging efficacy.
